response.title: what is the best power station for the money
response.answer:
For the best value in a portable power station, I'd focus on models with LiFePO4 (LFP) batteries, at least 1,000Wh of capacity, and enough AC output to run appliances.

The sweet spot for most buyers is a 1,000–2,000Wh power station. Smaller units are cheaper but have limited runtime, while larger units can get expensive and heavy.

My top brands to compare are EcoFlow, Bluetti, Anker SOLIX, and Jackery. The best deal depends heavily on current sale prices, because discounts can change which model offers the most capacity per dollar.

My top 3 picks — November 2026
Best capacity per dollar

BLUETTI AC180

$499.00

1,152Wh · 1,800W output · LFP battery

About $0.43/Wh. Great for camping, appliances, and emergency backup.

Seller: BLUETTI-US

Best overall balance

Anker SOLIX C1000 Gen 2

$549.99

1,024Wh · 2,000W output · 25 lb

More portable, stronger AC output, and very fast charging. My favorite if you frequently move it around.

Seller: B&H Photo

Shop

BLUETTI Elite 200 V2

$899

Reported November 15 price

2,074Wh · 2,600W output · 53 lb

Best for longer outages and more demanding appliances. Roughly double the capacity of the 1kWh options.

Price reference: PowerSized

Independent testing also favors the Anker C1000 Gen 2 as a particularly strong all-around value. 
Lab Tested & Ranked
+1

Which would I buy?

At these prices, I'd buy the BLUETTI AC180 for $499 if maximizing battery capacity per dollar is the priority. I'd spend the extra $51 for the Anker C1000 Gen 2 if portability and faster charging matter more.

One question that could change my recommendation:

What will you primarily use it for?

Home backup during outages
Camping / RV
Running appliances or power tools
Solar / off-grid use

What's your budget?

Under $500
$500–$1,000
$1,000–$2,000
$2,000+
Find my best value
